verdict.rationale: Crossmint is agent payments and wallet infrastructure with a policy engine and spending rules, so versioning those rules is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no versioning, review history, or rollback for automations or policies. Revocable delegations and expiring order intents are adjacent controls, not version management, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
